function overloaded(value: string): string;
function overloaded(value: number): number;
function overloaded(value: number | string): number | string {
  return value;
}

function first(): void {}

function second(): void {}

if (true) {
  function nestedFirst(): void {}

  // Documents the second nested function.
  function nestedSecond(): void {}
}

export function exportedFirst(): void {}

export function exportedSecond(): void {}

namespace Scope {
  function namespaceFirst(): void {}

  function namespaceSecond(): void {}
}

switch ("scope") {
  case "scope": {
    function caseFirst(): void {}

    function caseSecond(): void {}
  }
}

  static {
    function staticFirst(): void {}

    function staticSecond(): void {}
  }
}
